answer.summary: Spring context fails to start in every API and E2E test class, so 10 tests error out. The root cause is a classpath conflict: MetricsAutoConfiguration calls DefaultMeterObservationHandler.builder(MeterRegistry), which the Micrometer on the classpath lacks (NoSuchMethodError). The PR touches pom.xml and bumps spring-boot-starter-parent to 4.x, so the Spring Boot and Micrometer versions are probably mismatched. This is deterministic and will repeat on retry; fix the dependency versions.

evidence.quote: Correct the classpath of your application so that it contains compatible versions of the classes org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.autoconfigure.MetricsAutoConfiguration and io.micrometer.core.instrument.observation.DefaultMeterObservationHandler
